calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Lyca Mobile
calls.summary: Leica Digital is assessing ways to upgrade its digital platform across 20 countries, aiming to introduce personalization and A/B testing to improve user engagement and business growth. The team, led by Yasswant, expressed interest in alternatives to Adobe for experimentation tools due to investment concerns. The collaboration model assigns marketing the responsibility for experimentation metrics, while the digital team oversees technical support. Current gaps include the need for deeper personalization and server-side experimentation capabilities. The urgency to implement changes was emphasized, and Growth Book was highlighted as a cost-effective solution, offering AI-powered analytics and self-hosting options. Detailed discussions on competitive positioning against Adobe and Optimizely followed, focusing on the functionalities and cost implications.
calls.keywords: A/B Testing, Feature Flags, Personalization, Server-Side Experimentation, AI Integration, Digital Transformation
